content: Pranav Mishra contacted insurance agent Neha Kapoor to follow up on a home insurance policy. Pranav inquired about coverage for natural disasters like earthquakes and floods. Neha confirmed that the policy covers these events but noted a deductible of 5% of the total insured value. The conversation concluded with Pranav asking about the annual premium amount.

action_items: Neha Kapoor to provide annual premium details
